name: word_delete
description: Delete text (found once, or a range) or whole blocks: paragraph, table, span p:A..t:B, picture, note.

find.description: Text occurring once (in within, if given).

within.description: Block or span to search for find.

target.description: Range, block (a control cc: too), span p:A..t:B, picture d:, note fn:/en:.

collapse_space.description: Also delete the space the deletion would leave doubled. Default false.

force.description: Delete a heading though its content stays. Default false.
